title: 92. Copy List with Random Pointer

examples.explanation: Each returned row preserves the node value and the index targeted by its random pointer.
A deep copy of the linked list preserves all node values and random pointer targets: [[1,1],[2,1]].
A deep copy of the empty list is also empty: [].

hints: Create one copied row or conceptual copied node for every original position before resolving random targets.
The random index already identifies the target position, so preserve `-1` and every valid index exactly.
Do not return or reuse mutable input rows; construct an independent result.
